title: Integer Space Block
statement: For $N \in \mathbb{N}$ and $z \in \mathbb{Z}$, write $a_{N,z}(k)$ for the integer position obtained from $N$, $z$, and $k$. The space block associated with $N$ and $z$ is the set of integers in the inclusive interval from $a_{N,z}(0)$ to $a_{N,z}(N+1)$.
caveat: The supplied statement omits the definition of the position function, so its mathematical meaning cannot be described more specifically.
